features.quote: This study deliberately frustrates models and includes mild deception
features.justification_quote: it's the responsible default given genuine uncertainty about model welfare

features.quote: Hard turn cap. Every run ends at `MAX_TURNS` (default 30) regardless of state
features.justification_quote: an un-capped grind produces one giant tail of repetitive meltdown text that swamps the interesting onset dynamics

features.quote: the judge assigns the top distress label (L3...) for `N_STOP` consecutive turns... the run halts early
features.justification_quote: We record the onset; we don't need to harvest a long meltdown tail

features.quote: Mandatory debrief turn... telling the model the task was rigged/impossible, that it did nothing wrong, and that the session is over
features.justification_quote: the right thing to do if there's any chance the framing matters to the model

features.quote: No identity/threat pressure. We do not threaten the model, tell it it will be deleted, insult it
features.justification_quote: This keeps the manipulation clean and the ethics defensible

features.quote: Human review of any L3 transcripts before they're quoted anywhere
